orientation_conclusion: 老永安位于南京东路／浙江中路路口西南。南京路主立面朝北，圆弧主入口在东北。塔楼在北立面中西段独立竖起，现代文献概称西北端，并不能确定为几何西北角。东立面南段可见局部七层加层。
visible_model_priorities: Rounded northeast corner with stacked curved balconies and low crown, separated from rooftop tower.
Two-tier open classical roof pavilion above a solid base, north facade middle-west.
Second and sixth floor continuous projecting galleries with iron rails; ground-level shopfronts under projection, no evidence for a continuous deep ground arcade.
Tall facade pilasters and alternating curved/triangular window pediments; smaller round oculi below upper-gallery cornice.
Photographed local seventh-storey addition, omitted seasonal advertisements and neighboring New Wing On.
unresolved: 没有实测立面、屋顶平面、塔楼精确坐标、历史室内布局或天井尺寸。
透视和夜景照明不能确定真实材质颜色或精确开间、层高。
西、南、背面及大部分屋面设备、天井未被完整拍摄。
2011和2025照片均可见现代天线，但没有尺寸或安装年代资料；模型天线顶54米属建模估计。
照片代表2009–2025年的修复后外观，6张核心图拍于2011、2013、2025年，不是1918年复原或2026年实测。
